view_title: ฐานรากแบบที่ 2: แปลน/รูปตัด F1, F2 + รายการประกอบแบบฐานราก
warnings: Pile caps of foundation scheme 2 (ฐานรากแบบที่ 2, แบบตอกเข็มยาว) — joined to the S-02 plan only; NOT the spread F1/F2 of S-07.

F1 prints '4-DB16mm (เหล็กตะแกรง)' for the mat without saying whether 4 is per direction or the total; recorded count 4 as printed and flagged. Its '6-DB16mm (เหล็กยืน)' (vertical bars, from the column into the cap) and 'DB12mm. (เหล็กปลอก)' are kept as printed.

F2: the section's pile callout reads 'เสาเข็มจำนวน 1 ต้น' on a leader, but both the F2 plan (two pile crosses at 0.25 / 0.40 / 0.40 / 0.25 along the 1.30 side) and the section (two piles drawn under the cap) show TWO piles — two views against one label, so pile_count = 2; the label is read as applying to each leadered pile.

Pile notes (รายการประกอบแบบฐานราก กรณีต้องใช้ฐานรากตอกเสาเข็ม, 4 items) are kept on the pile object; items 2-4 (procedure per สพฐ. standard, blow count by Dannish / Engineering News formula with FS 2.5, no Hiley formula, broken/misplaced piles at the engineer's discretion and the contractor's cost) are procedural and recorded in note only.
Depth to the cap is printed 'Varie'; cover ~0.05 ม.
